**A hotfix for v0.8.** One fix. Everything else plays as before.

**No more black panels.** After starting the game from the title screen, the
painted panels and bricks of many walls could turn solid black, leaving only
their frames and seams lit, until you cycled through the F4 presets. They
now keep their colours from the first frame on, whatever preset you play.

## Known issue

- **Odd lighting after a mid-level change.** A light switch or similar change
  in the middle of a level can light the area oddly. Cycling through the F4
  presets fixes it.
